propositions: Context-limit escalation in pass-1 finder assigns a bare Anthropic model ID, bypassing the model-class table and crossing provider boundaries when the run's model is provider-qualified (e.g., Bedrock)
The _rung_target function compares rung class resolution against module constants, never using the actual run model as input, so provider-qualified primaries degrade to bare Anthropic family names
A Bedrock-qualified primary escalates to bare Anthropic ID, leaving cfg.model_provider untouched, resulting in invalid composite IDs like bedrock:claude-opus-4-8
The entry rung resolves to anthropic:claude-opus-4-8 and escalation to bare claude-opus-4-8 occurs on the common one-criterion retry, not only on deep escalation
Fix requires threading the run's primary model into _rung_target, comparing inferred providers, and dropping rungs that cross provider boundaries when both providers are determinable but differ
